title: Jaffa Rings, Tusked Beast, and a New Dawn
summary: In an orchard of jaffa, a human, once known to eschew important tasks, installs glowing rings, driven by an urgent, almost operatic, desire. Previously skunked by failure and haunted by kissers, they’ve vouched to postpone no longer. An eccentric, witchy figure, resembling a gargoyle, then tries to offload medicine. The teenager listens, discovering enemies. Their fancy plans flipped, they feel imposed upon, their old workshop vacated. Soon, within a cramped cockpit, a tusked kernel of a beast attacks desolated flocks. A wizard’s complete power makes them vulnerable. They must direct an archer to smack and shout, activating an electroshock defense. But finally, peace descends. A refugee, uninterested in past affronts, finds solace. Imperial inputs are solved, housed under a new lullaby, thanks to the aplomb of our young hero, no longer a crybaby.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls

scenes.sentence: In an orchard of jaffa, a lone figure, known for past failures, works with a determined urge.
scenes.prompt: Wide establishing shot of a sun-drenched, overgrown jaffa orchard at golden hour. A teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, is attempting to install a series of ornate, glowing rings around ancient trees. The scene has an operatic, almost majestic quality, but a skunked whisky bottle lies discarded nearby, hinting at past failures. Ripe tomatoes hang heavy, ignored. This human figure, previously known to eschew important tasks, now works with a determined urge, having vouched to postpone no longer. The air is thick with the scent of alchemy, despite the crybaby complaints of invisible kissers.

scenes.sentence: An eccentric, witchy figure offers strange medicine and a warning about encroaching enemies.
scenes.prompt: Medium shot of the teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, interacting with an eccentric, witchy figure resembling a gargoyle, whose home adjoins the orchard. The witchy figure, surrounded by pawpaw fruit and various medicine vials, tries to offload a peculiar order of enchanted hunting gear. The teenager, holding the cracked jade compass, listens intently as the witch's verbosity describes their enemies. Their fancy plan to visit the founders has been flipped, and they now feel imposed upon, their old workshop vacated. A matchbox lies discarded, hinting at a new, fiery resolve.

scenes.sentence: Within a cramped cockpit, a vulnerable hero faces a tusked beast and a wizard's complete power.
scenes.prompt: Tight close-up on the teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, now in the cramped cockpit of a cobbled-together airship. An owl perches on the console, its eyes glowing. The tusked, grain-fed kernel of a beast can be seen outside, attacking desolated flocks of smaller craft. The teenager must direct an archer, ready to smack and shout, to activate the electroshock defense. It's a vulnerable moment, peaceful dreams shattered, when the wizard's complete power becomes the kingmaker. The airship’s vulnerable hull is hit, but a peachy glow from the compass suggests a counter-measure.

scenes.sentence: Peace settles over the landscape, a lullaby of harmony after the imperial inputs are solved.
scenes.prompt: Wide overhead shot of a vast, tranquil landscape under soft, diffused light, now housed in harmony. The teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, is seen from above, standing immovably beside a globby, iridescent vibraharp. An angel-like refugee figure, uninterested in past affronts, is praying, while others enjoy bowls of stroganoff. Vulcanizing turbos hum softly in the distance, providing power. The pranksters who caused the initial conflict are nowhere to be seen, their journals solved. The imperial inputs are now stable, a lullaby of peace having finally settled, thanks to the aplomb of the young stalker.
